newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Aerospace firms on spinoff hope.
newsitem.headline: China Aerospace firms on spinoff hope.

text.p: Shares of China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd rose on Monday on hopes for stronger earnings following a possible spinoff in future, brokers said.
Shares of the electronics maker were up HK$0.225 or 7.2 percent to HK$3.350 around midday after they hit a morning high of HK$3.450. Volume was 83.55 million shares.
"Hopes for stronger earnings prospects and an exceptional gain from a possible spinoff fueled buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.

China Aerospace said earlier on Monday that as part of a business review it was consdering spinning-off part of its operations. The company said it was also reviewing the group's development and expansion of new and existing businesses.
Analysts said they expected the company to spinoff off its television manufacturing operations.
"It is likely to spinoff its TV manufacturing operation, one of the company's main sources of income apart from property investment," said Patrick Chia, Head of research of China Everbright Research.
"It (the TV operation) performs very well and the business is seen strong in potential," Chia said. "Its performance is also seen meeting the (Hong Kong bourse's) listing requirements."
Analysts said proceeds to be raised from the possible spinoff would also put the company in a stronger financial position, benefitting its future development into high-tech products.
